tagline: Up the river of the lakes, with the birds.
intro: The backway leaves US 52 south of Kenmare and runs north up the Des Lacs valley through the refuge, by the Lower, Middle and Upper Des Lacs lakes, to Ward County Road 1 at the refuge's north end. Interpretive panels stand along the way.

Meltwater from two great glacial lakes cut the valley about 10,000 years ago, and early trappers named its river Rivière des Lacs, the river of the lakes. More than 250 kinds of birds have been counted here, deer and moose can be spotted, and bald eagles pass through on the fall migration.

moments.title: Munch's Coulee Trail
moments.text: A one-mile trail on Lower Des Lacs Lake passes a bench by the water, then climbs through upland prairie to a view over the lake, the marshes and the valley.

moments.title: Kenmare
moments.text: In the town park stands a wind-powered Danish mill that settlers built in 1902 to grind local grain, in a town the river briefly served by barge.
